sources.title: TranslateGemma: A new family of open translation models
sources.snippet: "TranslateGemma" is a new suite of open translation models built on Gemma 3 in 4B, 12B, and 27B sizes. These models translate across 55 languages and are efficient without sacrificing translation quality.
